description:
Tracks that SOUND like one seed track or a set of up to 10, optionally restricted by
    tempo, key, genre, year, chart or audio-feature ranges — e.g. "like these three, but
    120-128 BPM in 8A or its neighbours": seed_tracks=[...], min={"tempo": 120},
    max={"tempo": 128}, key="8A", harmonic=true.

    Ranked mainly on a PANNs audio embedding (how the recording sounds) blended with an
    audio-feature similarity. Results are one per recording, with `score`, `genre_relation`
    to the seed and, with several seeds, `matched_seed`. With filters, results are the
    closest-sounding tracks that pass every filter, and `filters` reports what was applied
    and how many catalog tracks each one removed (`dropped_by`) — loosen the largest if the
    list is short. Use get_recommendations instead when you want preferred target values
    (target energy etc.) rather than hard filters. Costs 1 quota unit.
    PANNs (Kong et al., 2020) is used under CC BY 4.0.

blend.description: With several seeds: 'all' (default) = sounds like the set as a whole, best when the seeds share a style; 'any' = every seed gets its own neighbours, interleaved — use it when the seeds are from different genres, where 'all' would average them into tracks that sound like none of them.
blend.title: Blend

charted.description: Filter — true = only tracks with a known chart placement.
charted.title: Charted

cross_genre.description: Genre lane: 'auto' (default, keep results mixable with the seed's genre), 'allow' (genre-blind), 'strict' (seed's genre family only).
cross_genre.title: Cross Genre

exclude_same_artist.description: Drop other tracks by the seed artist(s).
exclude_same_artist.title: Exclude Same Artist

explicit.description: Filter — true = explicit only, false = non-explicit only.
explicit.title: Explicit

genre.description: Filter — comma list of catalog genre names, e.g. 'house'. An unknown name is rejected with close matches.
genre.title: Genre

harmonic.description: Widen each key to its harmonically compatible keys.
harmonic.title: Harmonic

include_subgenres.description: Also match every subgenre of a top-level genre.
include_subgenres.title: Include Subgenres

key.description: Filter — comma list of keys: Camelot ('8A'), Open Key ('1m') or names ('A minor').
key.title: Key

max.description: Filter — HARD upper bounds, e.g. {'tempo': 128}. Same attributes as `min`.
max.title: Max

min.description: Filter — HARD lower bounds on the results, e.g. {'tempo': 120, 'energy': 0.6}. Attributes: acousticness, danceability, duration_ms, energy, loudness, tempo, valence.
min.title: Min

min_chart_peak.description: Filter — best chart position required, as chart_peak (100 = a number one).
min_chart_peak.title: Min Chart Peak

seed_isrcs.description: Several seeds by ISRC (up to 10 together with seed_tracks).
seed_isrcs.title: Seed Isrcs

seed_tracks.description: Several seeds: catalog itunes_track_ids (up to 10 together with seed_isrcs).
seed_tracks.title: Seed Tracks

tempo_match.description: With a tempo bound: 'exact' (default) or 'half_double' (also match double/half the range).
tempo_match.title: Tempo Match

track_id.description: One seed: a catalog itunes_track_id (from search_catalog or get_audio_features). Omit when using seed_tracks / seed_isrcs.
track_id.title: Track Id

name: find_similar_tracks
title: Find Similar-Sounding Tracks
